blocks.text: Psalms 18 contains 50 verses. It opens with: I love thee, O Jehovah, my strength. It concludes with: Great deliverance giveth he to his king, And showeth lovingkindness to his anointed, To David and to his seed, for evermore. Psalm 19 For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. Supplied contextual evidence for this passage adds: Sheol, engulfing waters, mountain roots, and the pit use poetic death imagery familiar from Psalms; they can portray mortal peril without proving literal death in the fish.
